page.overview:
What is East Blue?

The East Blue is the ocean which makes up the east part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the North Blue by the Red Line and the South Blue by the Paradise half of the Grand Line.

The East Blue is commonly known as the weakest of all the seas. Pirates who are considered powerful and threatening in this sea are regarded as low rate compared to pirates from the other seas and especially in the Grand Line. Because of this, it is also seen as a symbol of peace by those on the side of justice. Ironically, despite its poor fame, the East Blue was the birthplace of the most famous pirate of all time, the late Pirate King Gol D. Roger. In the anime, it is also referred to as the .

Many other powerful and world-renowned characters also hail from the East Blue: Marine hero and Vice Admiral, Monkey D. Garp; the emperor Monkey D. Luffy, the pirate of the Worst Generation, Roronoa Zoro, as well as their crewmates Nami, a navigator, and Usopp, a sniper; and the Revolutionary Army leader, Monkey D. Dragon, and his right-hand man, Sabo. Other notable pirate crews from this sea include the Spade Pirates and the Barto Club.

It was the setting of the first six arcs of the manga and anime and the anime-only Warship Island Arc.
